blocks.p: The *Immersive or simple* section of *ZeD setup* sets how six parts of the screen are drawn: the belt, the devices, the watch, the dashboard, the Survival Guide and the identity card. *Immersive* draws the real thing and *Simple* draws a plain card with the same buttons and readings, in the same order.

caption: Figure 45-1
The Immersive or simple section of ZeD setup.
Figure 45-2
The watch, Simple, left; the belt, both looks, right.

blocks.p: *Immersive* is the default. The *Access* preset, under *Additions*, picks *Simple* for the devices, the watch and the dashboard.

marks.text: Simple keeps every button and reading. Only the drawing changes.
The watch, plain: the time, the date, the temperature, the speed and the alarm, with the same buttons.

sticky.text: The real thing, or a plain card.

blocks.p: With *Devices* set to *Simple*, every radio, CD player, TV and two-way radio in the *Radio* tab is a plain card: each reading on a row, each button beside it. The ovens, the generator, the grill and the washers and dryers get plain cards the same way. With *Dashboard* set to *Simple*, the dashboard is a plain strip with the speed, the gauges, the lamps as dots and every switch as a button.

caption: Figure 45-3
A radio, Simple, top; the dashboard, Simple, bottom.

marks.text: Every reading on a row, every button beside it.
Signal, presets, headphones and battery, in the face's own order.
The lamps are dots. Every switch is a button.
